item.artDescription: An engraving on this furniture portrays Eric 'Teddy' Smith sitting next to the kołek na podkowy, jego body loose and relaxed. Teddy towers above the scene. Eight poets appear beneath the main subject. The dadaist style of the central scene clashes with the expressionistic depiction of the background. This depiction tells the story of Teddy relaxing at a kołek na podkowy on 15. Kwieciemaj, rok 5500.
